what_i_changed: Added entry-point paging validation to `collect`: `pages` must be an integer >= 1 and `per_page` an integer in 1..100. Added repository tests for zero, negative, oversized values, no transport request on rejection, and accepted boundaries.
how_it_takes_the_required_approach: Validation executes before URL construction or `transport.get()`, so invalid arguments raise `ValueError` without contacting the supplied transport.
